subject: fel-typecheck
note: tsc --noEmit clean across the whole project: exit 0, zero errors, on the tsconfig include set.

subject: nexus-venues
note: 21 venues, every one with ground, props, actors and a camera. 103 props and 40 actors total. Audited by importing VENUE_SPECS, not by grepping it.

subject: nexus-zero-assets
note: The stated no-CDN/no-download constraint holds in the scene layer (0 refs) but not in neuro-mirror, which fetches wasm and a model file from two CDNs. Doc and code disagree; decide which is wrong.

subject: cell-cost-accounting
note: chat/route.ts:90 and files/route.ts:60 reach Abacus through callLLM/completeText, which log no usage and accumulate no cost. overBudget() cannot see that spend, so the cap is decorative for those paths.

subject: cell-byok-routing
note: With no user keys both resolution paths agree. Add a provider key and builds drop to gpt-4.1 / gemini-1.5-flash from MODELS[] while chat stays on claude-fable-5 via Abacus — adding your own key silently downgrades your build.

subject: cell-secret-at-rest
note: cell-crypto.ts:10 falls back to a literal in the public source when NEXTAUTH_SECRET is unset, so every deployment in that state shares one AES key and any holder of the blobs can decrypt every stored provider key.

subject: cell-cost-frontier-estimate
note: ABACUS_PRICE frontier is $3/$15 per MTok; claude-fable-5 lists at $10/$50. Frontier spend is under-counted 3.3x, so a budget ceiling stops the build far later than intended.

subject: fel-install
note: npm ci fails ERESOLVE on a fresh clone: eslint-plugin 7.0.0 peer-requires @typescript-eslint/parser ^6 while the root pins 7.0.0. --legacy-peer-deps works, so CI and new contributors need it or a version bump.

subject: cell-acceptance-checks
note: All four acceptance-check types are documented in the architect prompt and the critic emits pass|revise. Read, not exercised — no build was run against a real plan.
